Upstream d41f1ef92b "Update Bravura to 1.482" replaces the bundled Bravura font (fonts/bravura/Bravura.otf 512924 -> 889228 bytes, BravuraText.otf 1236512 -> 3056000 bytes) and its glyph metadata (bravura_metadata.json -> Bravura.json, fontVersion 1.392 -> 1.482), so the rendered notation glyph outlines in this fixture change the PNG/SVG/PDF bytes; page geometry is unchanged (PNG stays 1191x1684 and the PDF stays one page). Executed isolation on both hosts: re-running the golden lane with only fonts/bravura/{Bravura.otf,BravuraText.otf,metadata.json} taken from d41f1ef92b^ (everything else at the synced engine e9136ee340) reproduces the stored reference exactly (windows and linux: 317 identical, 46 allowed, 0 different, result PASS); with the 1.482 files staged the same run gives 308 identical, 46 allowed, 9 different, so no other change in 0ea613ff3426..2abc2de1de affects these outputs.
